Drupal module that connects a site to Pendulum Arc. An empty keyphrase list no longer replaces Arc for v0.3.2.

**Min version support:**
- Drupal **11**
- PHP **8.3** with the sodium extension

**Requires:**
- A Pendulum Arc account, and an API key or Arc sign-in
- Real-time SEO, or the Drupal CMS SEO Tools recipe, when a site wants focus keyphrases. The module does not require either one

**Runtime support:**
- Drupal 11

**Changes since v0.3.1:**
- The release gate passes PHPCS. A report helper keeps a blank line after the function, and a hash test method uses lower camel case
- Sync keyphrases still does not send a replace when this site has no focus phrase and no page phrases. Arc keeps the list it already has
